title: gpt-5, gpt-5-mini, gpt-5-nano and o3 shut down on 2026-12-11 (Responses API)
summary: On 2026-12-11 OpenAI shuts down gpt-5 (2025-08-07), gpt-5-mini (2025-08-07), gpt-5-nano (2025-08-07) and o3 (2025-04-16), plus fine-tunes of these models. This advisory covers calls to the Responses API (POST /v1/responses) that send one of these exact model names (or their dated snapshots); they fail from then on. Newer models such as gpt-5.1 or gpt-5.5 are not hit. openai-gpt-5-o3-shutdown-2026-12-11 covers chat completions; openai-gpt-5-pro-o3-pro-shutdown-2026-12-11-responses covers gpt-5-pro and o3-pro.
migrationNote: Search request bodies and config for these model names and switch them: gpt-5 and o3 to gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5-mini to gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5-nano to gpt-5.6-luna, the replacements OpenAI's deprecations page names. Re-run fine-tunes on a supported base model. The same model names also stop working on chat completions (openai-gpt-5-o3-shutdown-2026-12-11).

provenance.quote: On June 11, 2026, we notified developers using older GPT-5 and o3 model snapshots of their deprecation and removal from the API on December 11, 2026.
